text:
aria: Quick note — new users hitting our sample-app sometimes see schema validation errors when they enable JSON-mode + tool calling. Repro below.

leo: Steps?

aria: 1) npx redwood-quickstart -> sample app
2) registerTool that returns a JSON string payload
3) make chat.call({ json_mode: true, tools: [...] })
Observed outputs: backtick-wrapped JSON, or doubly-escaped strings, e.g. `\`{\\\"cmd\\\":\\\"open\\\"}\`` or `\\\"{\\\"cmd\\\":\\\"open\\\"}\\\"`. ajv throws.

sophie: I dug into the SDK helper — it has a "safeWrap" branch that adds backticks/escapes for UI safety. It doesn't check whether the caller asked for structured JSON.

matt: Also seeing a few auth refresh flakes locally around same timeframe: logs show multiple concurrent refresh attempts and occasional RetryError: auth refresh failed. Could be unrelated but bad UX together.

leo: Proposed short-term fixes: add an env toggle REDWOOD_SKIP_SAFE_WRAP for quickstart; and change helper to skip wrapping when request.json_mode===true or when response.metadata?.format==='json'. Also add SDK util parseWithRaw that returns {ok:false, error, raw}.

sophie: I'll open a small PR for the helper change and add unit tests for: backtick-wrapped, escaped-string, and plain JSON. Test should assert parseWithRaw.raw preserves original text.

aria: For auth: infra should ensure AuthManager exposes a single refresh promise so queued requests await it rather than triggering parallel refreshes. If a refresh fails, return clear RetryError with code and include request id.

matt: Filed infra ticket #5721 for debounce refresh; assigned to infra.

auth-bot: ticket-5721 created: "AuthManager: serialize token refresh and improve retry error clarity".

leo: After fixes: 1) release patch devex-sdk 2) bump sample-app template 3) publish quickstart note.

aria: I'm adding a small troubleshooting snippet to quickstart README showing how to toggle the env and how to log raw responses.

sophie: PR opened — will link when CI runs.
